cases.title: Verify Classic and Modern themes exist under themes preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open. Steps: Navigate to themes preferences. Expected: Both Classic and Modern themes shall exist under the themes preferences.

cases.title: Verify Classic theme display
cases.description: Preconditions: Themes preferences is open. Steps: Select Classic theme. Expected: Classic theme shall be displayed as in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Modern theme display
cases.description: Preconditions: Themes preferences is open. Steps: Select Modern theme. Expected: Modern theme shall be displayed as in the given image.

cases.title: Verify Theme Preferences item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open. Steps: Open View menu. Expected: Theme Preferences item shall be available under View menu.

cases.title: Verify Get New Themes item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open. Steps: Open View menu. Expected: Get New Themes item shall be available under View menu.

cases.title: Verify Classic item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open. Steps: Open View menu. Expected: Classic item shall be available under View menu.

cases.title: Verify Modern item under View menu
cases.description: Preconditions: Browser is open. Steps: Open View menu. Expected: Modern item shall be available under View menu.

opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-grounded, executable, distinct, and directly map to the supplied requirements without any blockers or contradictions.
The test cases G-002 and G-003 rely on an external visual reference ('as in the given image') which is not provided, making the expected behavior unverifiable and ambiguous.
confirmed_blockers: Requirement R-176 and case G-002 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display untestable.
